## Which rules

<!-- Rule IDs, e.g. MOVE-004 and MOVE-007. Name every rule involved, not just one. -->

## What kind of problem

<!-- Pick one and delete the rest. -->

- **Contradiction** — two rules say incompatible things
- **Gap** — a legal situation no rule answers
- **Ambiguity** — one rule reads two ways and both are defensible
- **Duplication** — the same rule is stated in more than one place, so they can drift

Quote the rules. A concrete situation is worth more than a description: "a unit
